Name: Farm Plots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod was originally meant to be part of a bigger Stardew Tycoon project, but I'm releasing it first because I think it will be useful on its own as well!

[youtube]yQoRhd1AKqE[/youtube]

Open the menu by pressing a key combination (default [b]LeftShift + F[/b]).

[size=5][b]Creating and Removing Plots[/b][/size]

With the menu open:

You can drag [b]with the [b]left [/b]mouse button[/b] on an area to create a farm plot. You can extend farm plots by dragging starting from within an existing farm plot.

You can remove farm plot tiles by dragging (or clicking) [b]with the right mouse button [/b]starting from within the target farm plot.

Left clicking on an existing farm plot selects that plot for setup.


[b][size=5]Farm Plot Setup
[/size][/b]
At the top of the menu there are four tabs, one for each season, letting you set a program for each season.

The second section shows seeds that can be planted in the given season, including those it is too late to plant. The mod [b]will not[/b] plant seeds when it is too late to plant them in the current season, but you can still create a program with them.

The third second shows all fertilizers in the game.

The fourth section has the following toggles in order:

[list]
[*][b]Harvest[/b] - toggle to automatically harvest crops at the start of the day when they become ripe, placing the harvest in the nearest chest or dropping on the ground.
[*][b]Till[/b] - toggle to automatically till the soil, removing twigs, grass, weeds, etc.
[*][b]Buy[/b] - toggle to buy seeds and fertilizer if they are not found in a chest in the current location, if they being sold in the seed shop and the player has enough money.
[*][b]Active[/b] - toggle to activate program, causing it to check at the beginning of every day.
[*][b]Update[/b] - press to make the program run immediately as though it were the beginning of the day.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

Seeds and fertilizer can be placed in a chest in a plot's location, and the mod will send harvest to the chest nearest to each tile.

This mod works for garden pots as well.

There may be bugs. Some bugs are good for farms. Some are not.
